scope: Read-only review of the four owned structural-companion analysis files and bounded local host fault probes; safe to commit as preparatory draft analysis evidence.
closed_important_findings: Every scheduled timing identity is reserved; another timing attempt cannot be relabeled as a diagnostic capture even with consistently rehashed route and counter files.

Known same-host overlap invalidates the affected timing metrics and embedded same-run counts. All usable declared diagnostic windows, including failed/partial captures, participate before qualification; both sides of diagnostic overlap lose structural qualification. Uncontrolled growth is kept unknown.

Successful captures and raw counter ledgers both require explicit status=ok/error=null. Failed, partial, contradictory and missing outcomes cannot qualify; supplied actual outcome fields remain retained in structural_attempts.
additional_strengthening: Readable coverage-plan and correspondence-rule artifact descriptors must match the policy hashes frozen before A/A; bare external policy promises do not qualify.
broader_test_scope: Owner full host suite reported 295 OK / 3 skips before the final bounded overlap closures. Final-source targeted seven regressions and positive controls were rerun; no full firmware/native matrix was required or performed for these analysis-only changes.
limits: These are analysis contracts and invented host fixtures; no native counter collector or structural measurement is qualified by this review.

Hash/path/metadata consistency does not authenticate a reviewer, establish that measurements actually occurred, or prove coverage/correspondence/interference assertions. Actual factual independent method and evidence review remains required before native companions qualify.

Valid untraced timing may be extracted and baseline-only A/A planning may proceed without private telemetry. Combined performance remains INCONCLUSIVE until every required structural pair is qualified; independently qualified growth remains REGRESSION.
